plugins.description: Brief → Direction → Build → Audit for interface work. A DESIGN_MAP.md direction file, tiered session boot, hooks (slop-scan, motion-gate, prompt-router, session-start), user-invocable skills (design-brief, direction, slop-audit, interface-check, motion-craft, motion-review, stress-ui, brand-method) and review agents (design-critic, interface-reviewer, motion-reviewer).
